data.title: Battery Mineral Resources appoints interim CFO
data.description:
• Battery Mineral Resources (BMR:CA) said on Friday that it appointed Sergios Abad as the interim chief financial officer after CFO Jennifer Fulton Anderson resigned, stating personal reasons.
  • Abad is currently the CFO of the company's Punitaqui Mining Complex.
  • The company has begun a search for a permanent Chief Financial Officer.

data.title: Bri-Chem CFO Tony Pagnucco takes on additional COO responsibilities
data.description:
• Bri-Chem (BRY:CA) said on Friday that it appointed Tony Pagnucco as its chief operating officer, effective immediately.
  • Pagnucco will assume this role in addition to his CFO responsibilities, the company said.
  • The appointment is part of Bri-Chem's ongoing efforts to strengthen operating performance, improve profitability, and increase sustainable cash flow. 
  • Press Release

data.title: Datavault AI to shift to OTC market as Nasdaq suspension looms
data.description:
• Datavault AI (DVLT) announced on Friday that its shares are expected to move to the OTC market on November 17, following Nasdaq's decision to suspend trading.

  • The suspension follows the company's failure to meet Nasdaq's $1 minimum bid price requirement and its stock closing below $0.10 for 10 consecutive business days.

  • Datavault AI plans to request a hearing before the Nasdaq Hearings Panel to seek an extension and restore its Nasdaq listing.

  • The company intends to present a plan to regain compliance with Nasdaq's listing requirements.

data.title: Incyte won't move ahead with phase 3 trial of ovarian cancer asset
data.description:
• Incyte Corp. (INCY) has decided to put the brakes on the phase 3 MAESTRA-3 trial that was expected to begin this quarter for INCB123667 in combination with Avastin (bevacizumab) as a first-line maintenance therapy for ovarian cancer. 
  • The company noted the decision was made "based on the prioritization of its clinical development portfolio and was not based on any safety or efficacy findings from the INCB123667 clinical program."
  • Incyte said that the determination will not have an impact on financial guidance or its long-term outlook.

data.title: Nasdaq gains 2% in a bumpy week for Wall Street; Nvidia loses ~13%
data.description:
The Nasdaq Composite Index (COMP:IND) ended in the red on Friday in a tumultuous week for markets following the ouster of Nvidia (NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang. The index was down 0.91%.

Nasdaq kicked off the week on a positive note, with the index climbing as much as 3% in the early hours of Monday as tech stocks staged a strong rebound after the previous week’s losses. However, the index endured a bumpy ride as Huang’s resignation and a softer-than-expected CPI report weighed on investors’ sentiment.

Despite a volatile run, the tech-heavy index rose 2.27% for the week.

Nvidia shares lost nearly 13%, becoming the second-highest detractor for the week, trailing closely behind Strategy (MSTR). Strategy shares suffered after MSCI confirmed it would remove the Bitcoin treasury company from its global equity benchmarks, effective at the close on November 30.

Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) shares soared this week, gaining nearly 19% on its deal with Google Cloud. The stock also benefited from William Blair upgrading it to Outperform, citing an opportunity to benefit from the Nvidia (NVDA) related fallout.

Top five gainers of the week:

Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) +18.93%

Broadcom (AVGO) +18.16%

Monolithic Power Systems (MPWR)   16.81%

Astera Labs (ALAB) +16.32%

Rocket Lab (RKLB) +15.94%

Top five decliners of the week:

Strategy (MSTR) -13.43%

Nvidia (NVDA) -12.75%

Moderna (MRNA) -12.12%

Nebius Group (NBIS) -10.51%

PDD Holdings (PDD) -4.89%

data.title: Steppe Gold Ltd. reports Q3 results
data.description:
• Steppe Gold Ltd. press release (STGO:CA): Net profit attributable to shareholders of the company was $37,389 for the third quarter and $56,336 for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $7,066 and $22,677, respectively, in 2025. 
  • Revenue increased to $86,570 in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $29,398 in the same period in 2025, reflecting higher gold sales volumes and higher realised gold prices. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, revenue was $201,599, compared to $94,093 in the corresponding period in 2025.

data.title: U.S. coach Mauricio Pochettino named new coach for Manchester United
data.description:
Manchester United has confirmed that U.S. Men’s National coach Mauricio Pochettino has been named the football club’s new manager amid hopes that the former Tottenham and Chelsea manager will work his magic on 18th place Manchester.

Pochettino is credited with taking Tottenham Hotspur to the UEFA Champions League final in 2019 and winning the Ligue 1 title for Paris Saint-Germain before leaving in 2022 to later joint Chelsea the following year.

Manchester United (MANU) has had a disappointing start to the season with just one win, 4 losses, and 5 draws, making this season the worst start for the club in 40 years and putting Manchester United precariously close to relegation.

On Thursday, the club announced that an “extremely difficult conclusion was made in order to achieve our ambitions,” and Carrick was removed as manager following a meeting between director of football Jason Wilcox, CEO Omar Berrada, and co-owner Sir Jim Ratcliffe.

Fortunately, the disappointing performance of the club has not had a meaningful impact on Manchester United’s (MANU) share price given its three major sources of revenue (broadcasting, merchandising, and matchday). After an 18% retracement from the $24.45 high in August, MANU bounced off the 200-day moving average to recover back towards the $24 per share level.

data.title: Medline bed deaths rise to seven
data.description:
• Following an FDA alert in October regarding a fire hazard with its hospital beds that led to two deaths and 16 injuries, Medline (MDLN) upped the number of deaths associated with the issue to seven.
  • As of Nov. 8, the company also said 35 serious injuries have been reported.
  • "Medline will soon begin distributing new repair and replace Customer Guides to patients and users of all relevant Medline Brand beds, rails, mattresses and accessories, in line with previous updates," Medline said on Friday.

data.title: Xylem launches $1.5B share repurchase program
data.description:
• Xylem (XYL) on Friday announced a new share repurchase program of its common stock of up to $1.5 billion, effective immediately.
  • Repurchases may be made from time to time on the open market or in privately negotiated transactions, the company said, adding that it intends to be opportunistic in its repurchases based on market conditions and other factors and may suspend or discontinue the repurchase program at any time.
  • Press Release

data.title: Condor Resources CEO Chris Buncic to step down in December
data.description:
• Condor Resources (CN:CA) announced on Friday that President and CEO Chris Buncic will resign, effective December 23, 2026.

  • Buncic, who has led the company since April 2024, is leaving to pursue another opportunity.

  • CFO Jonathan Younie will serve as interim president and CEO until a permanent replacement is appointed.
